hooks.responsibility: Agent lifecycle hooks for session capture, startup recall and per-prompt recall.

integrations.responsibility: Client-specific event adapters and setup instructions.

memory.responsibility: Starter Markdown vault and the contract for persisted knowledge.

scripts.responsibility: Distillation, indexing, diagnostics, maintenance and opt-in memory workflows.

graph.responsibility: On-demand HTTP server for exploring links between memory pages.

skills.responsibility: Agent instructions for the optional memory, graph and e2e workflows.

commands.responsibility: User-invoked entrypoints for optional agent workflows.

e2e.responsibility: Optional e2e configuration template installed into downstream projects.

tests.responsibility: Repository regression tests with synthetic fixtures.

docs.responsibility: Architecture, repository boundaries and editable diagrams.
